annotations.title: NFTs for sale in a collection

description: Active marketplace listings of an NFT collection: asset name, price (ADA), marketplace, rarity rank when known, seller and listing time. Use it to find the cheapest or rarest NFTs currently for sale.

cursor.description: Value of `nextCursor` from the previous call, to get the next page.

limit.description: How many listings to return (1-50, default 10).

policyId.description: NFT policy id: 56 hex characters. Get it from `search` or `list_nft_collections`.

sort.description: price = cheapest first, recent = newest first, rarity = rarest first.

name: get_nft_listings
title: NFTs for sale in a collection
